title: Immunocytochemistry Staining Protocol
author: Simeng Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.thwej7e

steps.title: Grow cells on coverslips
steps.instruction: Grow cultured cells on cover slips or in wells overnight at 37 °C until they reach approximately 70–80 % confluence as a single layer at the time of fixation.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with freshly prepared 4 % paraformaldehyde in PBS for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse post‑fix
steps.instruction: Rinse cells three times quickly with PBS.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL blocking buffer per sample and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute the primary antibody to the recommended concentration in blocking buffer; add 200 µL per well for 8‑well chamber slides or 500 µL per well for 12‑well plates; incubate 2–3 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C; keep in the dark if using conjugated antibodies.

steps.title: Rinse after primary (surface)
steps.instruction: For surface staining, rinse three times quickly with PBS (approximately 10 minutes total).

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare fluorochrome‑conjugated secondary antibody in blocking buffer according to the manufacturer’s data sheet; add 200 µL per well for 8‑well chamber slides or 500 µL per well for 12‑well plates.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the samples for 1 hour at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Rinse after secondary (surface)
steps.instruction: For surface staining, rinse three times quickly with PBS (approximately 10 minutes total).

steps.title: DAPI counterstain
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with DAPI for 15 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Final washes
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS; after the third wash, leave PBS in the wells.

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Image CD31 using 488 nm excitation and DAPI using 388 nm excitation.
